Tab object `isPinned` not correctly updated after pinning tab
Testing #145585

1. Pin a tab
2. `onDidChangeTab` event fires but tab object has `isPinned` set to false, also `isPreview` is set to true
I’ll trace the tab pinning update path and add a regression test for the event payload.

tools.command: sed -n '630,790p' src/vs/workbench/common/editor/editorGroupModel.ts && sed -n '250,290p' src/vs/workbench/browser/parts/editor/editorGroupView.ts && git log -S"isPinned: group.isSticky" --oneline --all -- src/vs/workbench/api/browser/mainThreadEditorTabs.ts | head -10

steps.text: The issue is in the main-thread DTO mapping: `isPinned` is derived from the separate “sticky” state, while preview changes only update `isPreview`. I’m correcting both the initial DTO and the pin-transition update to use the editor group’s pinned state.

tools.command:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /app/src/vs/workbench/api/browser/mainThreadEditorTabs.ts
@@
-			isPinned: group.isSticky(editorIndex),
+			isPinned: group.isPinned(editorIndex),
@@
-		// Whether or not the tab has the pin icon (internally it's called sticky)
-		tab.isPinned = group.isSticky(editorIndex);
+		tab.isPinned = group.isPinned(editorIndex);
@@
-		// Whether or not the tab has the pin icon (internally it's called pinned)
+		tab.isPinned = group.isPinned(editorIndex);
 		tab.isPreview = !group.isPinned(editorIndex);
*** End Patch
